en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and rolling hills. In the foreground and center are dense clusters of traditional multi‑story houses with gabled roofs, several larger institutional or factory-like buildings, and a tall industrial chimney. On the left stands a prominent castle complex with towers and a fortified appearance. Near the center is a church with a tall spire rising above the town. The landscape behind the settlement shows open farmland and scattered farmhouses. In the upper left corner of the card, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a serif typeface.
